!Series_title	"Transcriptome Analysis of Human Diabetic Kidney Disease (DKD Glomeruli vs. Control Glomeruli)"
!Series_geo_accession	"GSE30528"
!Series_status	"Public on Aug 03 2011"
!Series_submission_date	"Jul 08 2011"
!Series_last_update_date	"Dec 06 2018"
!Series_pubmed_id	"21752957"
!Series_summary	"We identified 1,700 differentially expressed probesets in DKD glomeruli and 1,831 in diabetic tubuli; 330 probesets were commonly differentially expressed in both compartments. The canonical complement signaling pathway was determined to be statistically differentially regulated in both DKD glomeruli and tubuli and was associated with increased glomerulosclerosis even in an additional set of DKD samples."
!Series_overall_design	"Affymetrix expression arrays were used to identify differentially regulated transcripts in 44 microdissected human kidney samples. Stringent statistical analysis using the Benjamini_Hochberg corrected 2-tailed t-test was used to identify differentially expressed transcripts in control and diseased glomeruli and tubuli."
!Series_overall_design	"This Series includes DKD and control glomeruli samples."
!Series_type	"Expression profiling by array"

!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1	"1mm x 1mm biopsy tissues were placed under an Olympus model SZX12 stereomicroscope using 90x magnification. The biopsy tissue was manually microdissected at 4C in RNALater for glomerular and tubular compartments using fine tip forceps. In general, 5 glomeruli that readily released from the capsule were collected and placed into cold RLT solution (Qiagen RNeasey kit). The corresponding tubulointerstitial and vascular compartment was placed into RLT solution also. For easier designation we called this component tubules. Dissected tissue was homogenized using a Powergen125 (Fisher) homogenizer and stored at -80C. RNA was prepared using RNAeasy mini columns (Qiagen) according to manufacterer's instructions. RNA quality and quantity was determined using a Lab-on-Chip Total RNA PicoKit (Agilent BioAnalyzer)."
